sources.title: Ecuador will require a transitory visitor visa from 1 September 2025
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Human Mobility
sources.officialityEvidence: Ecuador's live Foreign Ministry announcement supplies its operative 1 September 2025 visitor-visa nationality list. It names the People's Republic of China but does not identify a Macao SAR passport as a distinct document.
sources.supportingExcerpt: a aquellos nacionales de los países a los que actualmente se les solicita visa para ingresar al país

sources.title: Travel Convenience Privilege
sources.publisher: Identification Services Bureau of the Macao Special Administrative Region
sources.officialityEvidence: The live DSI service identifies Macao SAR Passport as the document to which its travel-convenience records apply. Its current dynamic interface did not expose a direct Ecuador result or issuance method; a portal's country omission is not treated as an eligibility rule.

unresolved.reason: No current Ecuadorian or Macao primary source directly maps an ordinary Macao SAR passport to Ecuador's short-visitor route and issuance timing. Ecuador's current visa list identifies the People's Republic of China, not Macao SAR passports; the current DSI interface provides no direct Ecuador result. The historic Macao announcement and removed legacy country page are not current proof. No mainland, Hong Kong, portal or omission inference is used to alter the fallback visa_free status.
